headerDisplay: Exposes contact sensors that open when the sun's azimuth and altitude fall within configured ranges and (optionally) a weather provider reports sunny conditions. Weather can be ignored for individual sensors.
footerDisplay: Azimuth is measured in degrees from north (0° = north, 90° = east, 180° = south, 270° = west). Altitude is degrees above the horizon (0° = horizon, 90° = zenith). Negative altitudes mean the sun is below the horizon. Enable Ignore Weather on a sensor to make it depend only on sun position. Weather errors fall back to position-only operation. Get a free OpenWeatherMap API key at https://openweathermap.org/appid. The One Call provider requires a One Call API 3.0 subscription (free for 1000 calls/day).

weatherProvider.title: Weather Provider
weatherProvider.description: Optional. Gate sensors by sky conditions. Configuration and request errors fall back to position-only operation.

provider.title: Provider Type

oneOf.title: One Call (OpenWeatherMap One Call 3.0: UV + clouds)

provider.description: Which weather metric to use for determining sunny/cloudy.

apiKey.title: OpenWeatherMap API Key
apiKey.description: Get a free key at openweathermap.org. The One Call provider requires a One Call API 3.0 subscription.

threshold.title: Cloud Cover Threshold (%)
threshold.description: owmCloudCover only: max cloud cover percentage to count as sunny (0–100, default 50).

uvThreshold.title: UV Index Threshold
uvThreshold.description: owmOneCall only: minimum UV index to count as sunny (0–20, default 3).

cloudThreshold.title: Cloud Cover Threshold (%)
cloudThreshold.description: owmOneCall only: max cloud cover percentage to count as sunny (0–100, default 50).

name.title: Sensor Name
name.description: The name shown in HomeKit. Must be unique.

azimuthMin.title: Azimuth Min (°)
azimuthMin.description: Start of the azimuth window (degrees from north, clockwise).

azimuthMax.title: Azimuth Max (°)
azimuthMax.description: End of the azimuth window. If min > max the range wraps through north (0°).

ignoreWeather.title: Ignore Weather
ignoreWeather.description: When enabled, this sensor opens and closes using only its sun position ranges, even when a weather provider is configured.
